tex_content.html:
Definition
[Forward and backward parabolic neighborhoods in a Ricci flow with surgery] ↗ def:metric-ball-spacetime ↗ def:compatible-with-time-vector-field

The backward neighborhood $P(x,t,r,-\Delta t)$ exists if there is a compatible embedding $B(x,t,r)\times (t-\Delta t,t]\to {\mathcal M}$. The forward neighborhood $P(x,t,r,\Delta t)$ exists if there is a compatible embedding $B(x,t,r)\times [t,t+\Delta t)\to {\mathcal M}$. Either is a parabolic neighborhood.
